actions: one passive kernel-log retrieval; no queries to TCON/GPIO or display controls
command:
set -euo pipefail
echo LOG_START; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime
dmesg | awk '/QDFTcon_SetQdTconPowerControl|m_set_power_control|QDFTcon_GetErrDetStatus|err detect gpio|QD_TCON_OFF|panel dpms:/ {if(length($0)>500)t++;a[n%64]=substr($0,1,500);n++} END{start=n>64?n-64:0;for(i=start;i<n;i++)print a[i%64];print "RETAINED_MATCH_COUNT",n+0;print "LONG_LINES_TRUNCATED",t+0}'
echo LOG_END; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id; cat /proc/uptime
